subject.title: Gateway: capability-gated replay signal for idempotent chat.send responses

question: Should cached `chat.send` replay state become a capability-gated field on the generic Gateway response frame?
rationale: The failure and consumer are concrete, but choosing a generic response-envelope contract rather than method-specific replay state establishes a durable protocol boundary.

options.title: Adopt replay-only metadata
options.body: Approve the linked PR's negotiated, closed `{ replayed: true }` response marker and in-tree client consumer.

options.title: Use method-specific state
options.body: Keep the generic response frame unchanged and encode replay state only in the `chat.send` response or error contract.

options.title: Decline same-key retry support
options.body: Document that clients must not retry a retryable error with the same idempotency key and make no protocol change.

recommendation.title: Adopt replay-only metadata
recommendation.body: Approve the linked PR's negotiated, closed `{ replayed: true }` response marker and in-tree client consumer.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history spans both the `chat.send` implementation and protocol schema, and the prior closing comment set the requirements for this follow-up.
